description:
Preserve complete repository context when checking a scoped lifecycle transition, so a valid container pointer outside the transition's dependency slice cannot block unrelated work.

## Background

Transition graph validation currently supplies the ancestor/dependent slice as both firing subjects and resolution context. A completed breakdown reachable through shared prerequisites can reference a valid container outside that slice; the evaluator then reports an unknown container even though whole-repository validation resolves it. Archival is one triggering topology, not the governing distinction.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Transition validation resolves container pointers and relationship context against the captured repository while retaining the intended transition firing scope.
- [hard] REQ-02: A transition sharing prerequisites with a completed breakdown succeeds when that breakdown's valid container lies outside the transition slice, including an archived container.
- [hard] REQ-03: Missing or ambiguous references relevant to the transition and required gates still block transitions; no force bypass or historical tracker rewrite is introduced.
- [hard] REQ-04: Scoped transition checks reuse the canonical graph evaluator and remain consistent with whole-repository validation.
title: Preserve complete graph context during scoped transitions
